'''Automated conveyors''' moved cargo drums within the holds of [[Rebel ship of the line|Rebel ships of the line]]. [[13-K]] took over such a conveyor, making it drop drums in an attempt to kill [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
